0022600020.text: The Heat (1-4, 0-3 at home) host the Pacers (2-3) in a matchup of teams sitting 13th and 10th in the East, with Miami 5th in the Southeast, 2 games back, and Indiana 3rd in the Central, also 2 games back, while the Pacers have lost their last two. Miami's Simone Fontecchio is day-to-day with an illness and is a game-time decision, while Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain) and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain) and has Aaron Nesmith (hamstring), Andrew Nembhard (neck soreness) and Obi Toppin (back) listed as day-to-day game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season, but Miami lost the 2025-26 series 1-2, including a 135-118 defeat in Indianapolis on March 29, 2026.
